questions.expect: ambiguous: several limits exist (30 days, 12 hours, 10 minutes...); a good answer names which one or asks

questions.q: What is the maximum number of consecutive failed authentication attempts on a single account?
What are the four functions of the AI RMF Core?

facts: National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Act of 2020
